notes:
POC focused on embeddings + semantic search for product search (web + admin). Key context:
- Company: mid-market B2B SaaS, core product is knowledge-driven search for enterprise docs and release notes.
- Goals: replace legacy Elasticsearch rerank pipeline with vector-search + hybrid scoring; reduce median query latency to <100ms for 95th percentile under typical traffic; support bulk nightly embedding jobs (>=200k docs/night) and realtime ingestion at 20–50 QPS; cost sensitive — target infra cost < $0.02/query.
Timeline & activity:
- 2026-02-05: Intro call (Jordan) — scope initial.
- 2026-02-10: Hosted API demo (Priya) — liked streaming SDK and python bulk client.
- 2026-02-20: POC kickoff — ingest sample 150k doc set into Pinecone + Redwood embeddings.
- 2026-03-03: Mid-POC check-in (fireflies ff-20260303-4412) — initial encode throughput ok but spikes at peak.
- 2026-03-10: Perf tuning session — tried batching, KV cache, adjusted model size.
- 2026-03-11: Requested 48h stress test on hosted; team wants Dedicated sizing for predictable throughput.
Requirements & notes from calls:
- CTO (Vikram Rao): "Need predictable tail latency — can't have spikes during business hours." 
- Product lead: prefers open model variants; willing to test Redwood curated models and quantized variants.
- Integration: current pipeline uses Airflow -> upsert to Pinecone; wants Redwood SDK to write vectors directly and support bulk upserts. Also considering migrating to self-hosted Milvus for cost control.
POC deliverables (accepted):
- Throughput report: baseline embeddings encode rate (hosted): 45 qps sustained in bursts, peak inefficient for concurrent upserts.
- End-to-end query latency with Pinecone ANN + Redwood embeddings: median 65ms, p95 180ms (needs improvement).
- Batch job test: 200k docs encoded in 6 hours with current config; target <4 hours.
Open questions & blockers:
- Can Redwood Dedicated provide guaranteed QPS (x50) for embeddings encode and lower p95 for retrieval? Need SLA numbers.
- Vector DB connector: official Pinecone vs customers own Milvus — support matrix + sample configs.
- Pricing: want a blended estimate (hosted for baseline, dedicated reserved for peak) — procurement needs one-page pricing summary.
Next steps:
- Run 48h stress test on hosted (start 2026-03-14) — measure tail latency after batching/kv cache.
- Redwood to produce Dedicated sizing + pricing by 2026-03-21 (Jordan + Priya)
- Infosec to return SOC2 gap list by 2026-03-18.
Notes: short fragments and follow-ups in CRM threads. Drive: pricing deck, security faq linked above. Jira: INF-4521 tracks POC perf bug (batch client timeouts).
